summary: Keep page-capped catalog walks out of authoritative sync snapshots while retaining their availability observations.
reason: A sync stopped by --max-pages is only a prefix of the catalog. Promoting it to the newest snapshot made drift report every entity beyond the cap as removed.
validated_outcome: PASS: incomplete class and camp page walks are marked truncated; truncated walks record openings history without creating a sync run; focused tests, full Go tests, go vet, and go build passed.
findings: Greptile P1: page caps created false removals in drift
reapply_notes: Preserve icpCollection.Truncated and route truncated collections through RecordICPOpenings rather than RecordICPObservations. Re-run TestIcpCollectMarksOnlyIncompletePageCapsTruncated and TestIcpRecordSyncObservationsDoesNotPromotePartialWalk.
